meta.name: brandkit
meta.description: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先推断品牌定位与象征,再生成一张品牌工具图:logo、配色、字体、UI 与实物样机按网格排成一块规范板。
howto.when: 当你要做 logo 概念、品牌规范板或视觉识别演示时触发;没指定布局时默认输出一张 3×3、4:3 或 16:10 的总览图。

howto.what_en: Claude first infers the brand strategy and metaphor, then generates one brand-kit image: logo, color, type, UI and mockups laid out on a grid board.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want logo concepts, brand-guidelines boards or identity decks; if no layout is given it defaults to one 3x3, 4:3 or 16:10 overview image.
